default.title: Salaried, one employer - ITR-1
default.line: Priya Demo Salaried: her pre-filled JSON, one Form 16 and the 26AS - the client made from them, nothing asked, ITR-1.

say.intro: A salaried client with one employer: start a new filing, pick An individual, and let the documents do the typing.
say.what: Salary from one employer, and some bank interest - two cards. The likely form says ITR-1, with its reason.
say.upload: Her pre-filled JSON, the Form 16 and the 26AS, dropped in together. Each is read for what it is.
say.client: The pre-filled JSON names her - PAN, name, date of birth - so the client is made and nothing is asked.
say.review: Review: what was understood, nothing missing - one button into My return, at the right step.

default.title: Two employers in the year
default.line: Arun Demo Twojobs changed jobs: the 26AS shows a second employer's TAN, the wizard asks for that Form 16.

say.intro: A client who changed jobs in the year - two employers, two Form 16s.
say.what: Changed jobs in the year brings Salary with it. The form follows: still ITR-1.
say.upload: The 26AS and the first Form 16 go in. The 26AS names him, and shows two employers' TANs.
say.client: The client is made from the 26AS. The popup asks only his date of birth.
say.hints: The second employer's TAN has no Form 16 here - the hint says so. Its Form 16 goes in, and the hint is gone.
say.review: Both Form 16s in, nothing missing - into My return, where the two employers' standard deduction is checked.

default.title: Salary, funds sold and a plot sold
default.line: Ravi Demo Salaried: two employers, a fund sale the AIS shows, a plot sold with 194IA TDS - CAMS and the deed figures asked for. ITR-2.

say.intro: Salary, mutual funds sold and a plot sold - the documents point to everything else.
say.what: Two employers, shares or funds sold, land sold - the form becomes ITR-2, for the capital gains.
say.upload: His Form 16 and the AIS go in first. The Form 16 names his PAN but not his name, and the AIS is locked.
say.client: The popup asks his name and date of birth. With the date, the locked AIS opens by itself.
say.hints: The AIS shows fund sales - upload the CAMS statement. The 26AS shows 194IA TDS on a plot - enter the sale. Another employer's TAN - its Form 16.
say.review: Every needed document in; the plot's sale figures wait in My return's Review.

default.title: A pensioner with interest
default.line: Savitri Demo Pensioner, 69: a bank pension, deposit interest - the senior-citizen limits from her date of birth. ITR-1.

say.intro: A retired client: a pension from the bank and interest on deposits.
say.what: A pension is salary - pick Salary or pension, and Interest and dividends. ITR-1.
say.upload: The pension Form 16, the 26AS and the AIS - all three read.
say.client: The client is made from the 26AS; her date of birth is asked once - it decides the senior-citizen limits and 80TTB.
say.review: Into My return: the interest under 80TTB, the senior slab in the old regime, both regimes compared.

say.intro: A partnership firm that trades, with a GST number and a turnover that needs a tax audit.
say.what: A partnership firm, then the kind of work: trading, GST, a tax audit, partners' salary and interest, stock, depreciation. ITR-5, with Form 3CD.
say.upload: The GST certificate and the partnership deed first. The certificate gives the GSTIN, the legal name and the constitution.
say.client: The client is made from the certificate - a partnership firm, its GSTIN on it. The popup shows the deed's partners and shares, to confirm.
say.hints: Then the 26AS, the books, the GSTR-3B returns and last year's ITR-5. Each goes where the firm's work happens: the books to Intake & map, the 26AS to Reconcile, the GST returns to the tax audit.
say.review: Review: the books came with their SF Refs and the 26AS is in, so the next screen is the Tax audit - Form 3CD by risk, then Compute & close.

default.title: Small business - only a bank statement (ITR-4)
default.line: Anil Trainer Demo runs a small gym with no books: one bank statement, the money classified, ITR-4 on 6% of the UPI receipts.

say.intro: A gym trainer with no books and no Form 16 - only a bank statement. Start a new filing and pick An individual.
say.what: One card does it: Small business - only a bank statement. The form says ITR-4, with its reason.
say.upload: The statement alone, dropped in. It is read row by row and checked: opening plus credits minus debits must be the closing balance.
say.client: The statement names the holder, the address and the refund account. Only the PAN, date of birth, mobile, e-mail and father's name are asked.
say.review: Review: nothing missing - one button into My return, at the Classify step.

more.say: Money in, grouped by who paid, each one guessed: customers, own money, a loan, a refund. Tap to change - the PhonePe credit is Not sure until you say what it is.

more.chapter: Turnover, profit and the GST limit
more.say: Customer receipts only are the turnover. At 6% they give the presumptive profit under 44AD; cash would be 8%. Below the GST limit, nothing to register.
The new regime against the old, the tax, and the late fee under 234F because the due date has passed. The cheaper regime is chosen for you.

more.chapter: The ITR-4 JSON and how to upload it
more.say: The JSON is checked against the department's ITR-4 schema. Download it, then follow the steps: log in, e-File, upload the JSON, pay, verify.

more.say: Money in, grouped by who paid, each one guessed: customers, own money, a loan, a refund. Tap to change - the PhonePe credit is Not sure until you say what it is.

more.chapter: Turnover, profit and the GST limit
more.say: Customer receipts only are the turnover. At 6% they give the presumptive profit under 44AD; cash would be 8%. Below the GST limit, nothing to register.
The new regime against the old, the tax, and the late fee under 234F because the due date has passed. The cheaper regime is chosen for you.

more.chapter: The ITR-4 JSON and how to upload it
more.say: The JSON is checked against the department's ITR-4 schema. Download it, then follow the steps: log in, e-File, upload the JSON, pay, verify.
